about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Deep is a co-op underwater exploration game where one wrong move could cost you your last breath. As a solo diver or part of a quirky rescue team, your mission is to dive deep into the ocean and locate the missing crew of a sunken submarine. Manage your oxygen, avoid deadly sea creatures, and push forward—how far into the deep can you really go?

WORK TOGETHER

Need a Fin?
You’ll need your teammates if you want to survive the dive. Navigate ever-shifting underwater currents, activate team gadgets, and boost each other through tight coral caves or past jellyfish storms. Share your oxygen wisely—or fight over it hilariously.

DIVE

The Ocean Doesn’t Forgive!
Plunge through 4 dangerous underwater zones, from sunken wreck fields to glowing trench mazes. Watch out for traps, toxic fish, and disorienting whirlpools. One wrong move and you’ll be gasping for air—or worse, fish food.

SURVIVE

Think Fast, Breathe Slow:
Scavenge oxygen tanks, sonar boosters, and weird sea snacks to stay alive. Patch up your diving suit between rounds, and keep an eye out for mythical artifacts that give you strange (and sometimes useless) powers. It's survival—but make it silly.

DIVING IS BETTER WITH FRIENDS

Multiplayer in Deep is friends-only—invite up to 3 other divers via Steam and explore the abyss together. Or go in solo if you're brave, foolish, or just don't like to share air tanks.

FEATURES

  • Dive with up to 4 players in online co-op

  • Proximity voice chat with bubbly effects

  • 4 unique underwater biomes full of hazards

  • Dangerous fish and useless sea cucumbers

  • Tons of upgradeable gear and gadgets

  • Campfires? Nah. Glowfish and weird coral instead

  • Silly character customization (yes, there are flippers)

  • Play solo or with friends

  • Ghost mode (for when your buddy "forgets" to revive you)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 7600xt or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
